title: Abodan Ho Nneɛma Ho Adwumfo
intro: Fa w’adwene bu anibuei bi a tumi wom, a wɔde ahoɔden ne ahokokwaw akyɛde ama, a ɛrediwene atrae akɛse agu mmepɔw so. Ná saa nnipakuw yi wɔ yiyedi kɛse ne adansi ho nimdeɛ soronko. Nanso, ɛmfa ho sɛ wonyaa kɔkɔbɔ ahorow a emu da hɔ no, wɔpaw ɔkwan bi a ɛbɛma wɔawie asɛm bi a ɛyɛ nwonwa na wɔn werɛ remfi da. So wubetumi ahu kuw yi a wɔn asɛm yɛ asuade a emu dɔ ma wɔn a wosusuw nneɛma ho nyinaa?
clues: Wɔmaa yɛn ahoɔden ne ahokokwaw, na ɛmaa yetumi twitwaa afie a ɛyɛ nwonwa guu mmepɔw so tẽẽ.
Wɔmaa yɛn sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛda adi pefee a efi Allah hɔ, abɔde soronko bi a na ɛsɛ sɛ wogyaw no a biribiara nhaw no ma yɛdidi.
Yɛn mpɔtam hɔfo bɛyɛɛ ahantan, na wɔkasa tiaa ɔsoro nkrasɛm a ɔbɔfo bi a ofi yɛn mu de bae no.
Yɛbɔɔ pɔw sɛ yɛbɛpira anwonwade sɛnkyerɛnne no, ɛmfa ho kɔkɔbɔ ahorow a ɛfa asotwe a emu yɛ den ho no.
Yɛbuu ahyɛde a ɛne sɛ yɛmma abɔde titiriw no nnom nsu mfi yɛn abura mu nna a wɔsesa mu no so.
Yehyiaa awiei a ɛyɛ hu, a ɔtopae biako pɛ a ɛyɛ hu bɔɔ yɛn wɔ yɛn mmarato adeyɛ no akyi.

arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verse: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. (26:158)
